gloss: right to vote; voting rights; suffrage

definitions.gloss: right to vote; voting rights; suffrage
definitions.explanation: The legal right to cast a vote in an election. In Japan it is granted to citizens aged 18 and over.

examples.japanese: {投票権|とうひょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I gain the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {十八|じゅうはっ}⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{投票権|とうひょうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You have the right to vote from age eighteen.

examples.japanese: {投票権|とうひょうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧だ。
examples.english: The right to vote is an important right that supports democracy.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧ (voting) + {権|けん} (right). The 〜{権|けん} suffix forms many "right to ~" words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票権|とうひょうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have the right to vote
- {投票権|とうひょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise one's vote

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧: the right to vote in elections — the formal legal term
- ⟦{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}→被選挙権：24950_hisenkyoken⟧: the right to be elected (to run for office)
